verdict.rationale: Drata offers a Trust Center feature (via SafeBase integration) with branding/URL setup and an analytics dashboard, plus APIs to 'manage your trust center programmatically' and 'accelerate security reviews', supporting the general capability of a hosted trust center for closing security reviews. However, no evidence explicitly confirms click-through NDA gating, live control status feeds, or a certifications/reports repository as described in the story. Missing for 10: explicit click-through NDA mechanism, live control status display specifics, certifications/reports catalog evidence, and independent/hands-on corroboration.
